integrity: Algebraic reductions, exact equilibrium count and stability signs are proved in RESULT.md; the standalone SymPy code checks symbolic identities and several admissible examples, not an infinite-domain theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only two urns and quadratic reinforcement; the critical-point domination probability and off-anti-diagonal stability types are not determined. The probabilistic threshold conclusion uses the published stochastic approximation framework; no independent mathematical audit is claimed.
title: An exact quadratic interaction threshold and nine-equilibrium phase diagram for two reinforced urns
